name: Save Text
description: Save incoming text, documents, or chunks to one file or multiple files and return artifact metadata.

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Destination path. In single-file mode this is the output file path. In separate-files mode this is treated as a folder name (suffix removed if provided) where generated files are written.

parameters.name: separate_files
parameters.description: When true, create/use the folder from output_path and save one file per document/chunk item as folderName_00001, folderName_00002, ...

parameters.name: extension
parameters.description: File extension used for generated files.
